definitions.gloss: mailing, sending by mail, postal delivery
definitions.explanation: The act of sending something through the postal service.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{郵送|ゆうそう}してください。
{郵送|ゆうそう}で{届|とど}きますか。
examples.english: Will it be delivered by mail?

examples.japanese: {郵送|ゆうそう}{料金|りょうきん}は{いくら|幾}らですか。

notes:
COMPOUND: {郵|ゆう} (mail) + {送|そう} (send)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {郵送|ゆうそう}する (to mail, send by post)
- {郵送|ゆうそう}で (by mail)
- {郵送|ゆうそう}{料金|りょうきん} (postage)
- {郵送|ゆうそう}{費|ひ} (postage cost)
- {郵送|ゆうそう}{先|さき} (mailing address)

RELATED TERMS:
- {郵便|ゆうびん} (mail, postal service)
- {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく} (post office)
- {配送|はいそう} (delivery, shipping)
- {発送|はっそう} (dispatch, shipping)
